Use this skill when the user asks to 把文件批量备份到乐享 / 批量上传附件到知识库 / 把工作区文件归档到乐享 / backup a folder to Lexiang. Covers the mandatory three-step upload chain (apply_upload -> HTTP PUT -> commit_upload), the exact-byte-size requirement that causes 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch, unsupported .zip/.svg extensions that silently fail after a 200 PUT, the difference between web drag-and-drop and the API channel, pre-signed URL escaping traps, and the parallel batching method that turns 3 round-trips per file into 3 rounds per batch.
skills.name: mo-乐享知识库批量备份
